title: Rewirable Circuits in Transformers with Loom Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.30634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose loom attention, which allows a Transformer to dynamically rewire its circuits at every token by interweaving a head's vertical attention over the outputs of earlier heads (to obtain its query, key and value) with its horizontal attention over tokens. We instantiate vertical attention efficiently with normalized and gated linear attention over a per-token matrix memory, which stores the compressed head outputs and serves as a second residual stream. This yields LoomFormer, a dual-stream architecture that splits control and content between the vector and matrix streams. Across model sizes and training token budgets in language modeling and downstream tasks, LoomFormer matches Transformers trained with over 3x compute and recent residual-stream baselines (HC/mHC, MUDDFormer, AttnRes) trained with ~1.7-2.8x. For example, trained on the same 300B tokens with only 2% extra FLOPs, LoomPythia-2.8B achieves ~1.6x the average downstream

translated_title: 基于Loom注意力实现Transformer中的可动态重连电路
translated_abstract: 我们提出了loom attention（织机注意力），它使Transformer能够在每个token处动态地重新连接其电路，方法是将注意力头对先前注意力头输出的“垂直注意力”（用于获取其query、key和value）与对token序列的“水平注意力”交织在一起。我们通过在每token矩阵记忆上使用归一化且门控的线性注意力来高效实现垂直注意力，该矩阵记忆存储压缩后的注意力头输出，并充当第二条残差流。由此我们构建了LoomFormer，一种双流架构，将控制信息与内容信息分别分配到向量流和矩阵流中。在语言建模和下游任务中，跨越不同模型规模和训练token预算，LoomFormer能够匹敌使用超过3倍计算量训练的标准Transformer，以及使用约1.7-2.8倍计算量训练的最新残差流基线（HC/mHC、MUDDFormer、AttnRes）。例如，在相同的300B token上训练且仅增加2%的额外FLOPs的情况下，LoomPythia-2.8B实现了约1.6倍的平均下游性能（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 提出loom attention使Transformer能在每个token处动态重连其注意力电路，通过垂直注意力与矩阵记忆构成的向量-矩阵双流架构，在仅增加约2%计算量的情况下达到超过3倍计算量训练的Transformer的性能。
en_tdlr: Loom attention enables Transformers to dynamically rewire their circuits at every token via a dual-stream vector-matrix architecture, matching Transformers trained with over 3x compute while adding only ~2% extra FLOPs.
